say: Iske baad shopping list bhoolna mushkil ho jayega.

steps.say: List? Shaam tak gayab. Dimaag shabd yaad nahi rakhta.
Lekin kahani? Kahani chipak jaati hai. Agle hafte bhi yaad rahegi.
Is trick ka naam hai Story Chain. Har cheez agli cheez se judi hui.

say: Pehli cheez, doosri cheez ke saath kuch karti hai.
Doosri, teesri ke saath. Aise hi aage.
Jitni pagal kahani, utni pakki yaad. 😄
Chaliye, aaj ki list se try karte hain.

steps.say: Ab kahani. Har picture ko dimaag mein dekhiye. 🎬
Aap ek bada glass doodh pee rahe hain.
Achanak, doodh se ek bread ka slice bahar nikalta hai. Naav ki tarah tairta hua! ⛵
Bread par ek kela baitha hai. Aapko dekh kar muskura raha hai.
Kela nahaa raha hai, ek gulabi sabun se. 🛁
Sabun ke bubbles ke andar chai patti udd rahi hai. 🫧
Chai patti neeche girti hai... aur 6 andon par land karti hai. Crack! 💥
Ek baar aur, jaldi se: doodh, bread, kela, sabun, chai, ande.
Aankhein band karke ek baar aur dekhiye. Phir bataiye.

say: Kahani ke order mein tap kijiye. Doodh se shuru.

quiz.no: Yeh nahi. Chawal kahani mein kabhi tha hi nahi.

say: Ab wahi test, jo shuru mein kiya tha.
Lekin is baar aapke paas kahani hai. 🔗
Aaj ki 6 cheezein kaun si thi?

steps.better: Dekha aapne? Kahani ne kaam kiya. Yahi hai Story Chain ki taakat. 💪
steps.same: Score zyada nahi badla, lekin ab aapke paas ek trick hai. Kal aur behtar hoga.

steps.hi: Bahut tez memory. Kahani banayi, aur kahani tik gayi. 🌟
steps.mid: Achha kaam. Kahani ne aadha kaam khud kar diya. 👏
steps.lo: Achhi shuruaat. Kal kahani aur pagal banayenge.
steps.homework: Aaj raat ek kaam: kal ki sabzi list ke liye ek pagal si kahani banaiye. Likhna nahi. Bas kahani. Kal milte hain! 👋
